evals.prompt: Create an interface called IEventBus in the reporter lib with two methods: publish that takes a string topic and a string payload (both const ref), and subscribe that takes a const ref string topic and returns nothing.
evals.expected_output: interface_event_bus.h with pure virtual methods, virtual destructor, namespace reporter, correct include guard format (if !defined), and mock_event_bus.h with MOCK_METHOD macros

evals.prompt: Create a concrete class EventBus implementing IEventBus in the reporter lib. It has a shared_ptr to a zmq context member and a map from string topic to a vector of string callbacks. Constructor takes a shared_ptr to IDependency.
evals.expected_output: event_bus.h with final keyword, override on methods, m_ prefixed members, explicit constructor, no implementations in header. event_bus.cpp with proper member init list, two blank lines between methods, namespace wrapping.

evals.prompt: Create a new lib called audit that depends on logger and filter_dtos. Just the scaffold — no starter interface needed.
evals.expected_output: audit/CMakeLists.txt with correct GLOB_RECURSE, POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON, alias target, BUILD_TESTING guard. audit/test/CMakeLists.txt with UNIT_TEST compile definition. Correct directory structure.
